resources.string: Each recording is saved here first; every finished part is copied to the network folder, checked, and then removed from this device.
Space to Use on This Device
The newest part of each recording waits here until it\'s copied. If the network folder can\'t be reached for a while, a recording stops cleanly once this fills up, keeping what it has.
A shared folder on a computer or NAS on your home network. Recordings go in it.

Use the computer\'s IP address (names often aren\'t found). On Windows, share the folder with Read/Write for that user and set the network to Private. If this box\'s VPN is on, it may need your home network let through.
Letting the folder past the VPN (it reconnects), then checking…
Type the computer\'s address and the shared folder\'s name, like \\\\192.168.1.20\\Recordings
